claim: Nike's net income was about $712 million in the third calendar quarter of 2026.
summary: The claim concerns Nike's net income for calendar Q3 2026 (July-Sept 2026), a period ending after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04. It cannot be established from existing knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Nike's net income was about $712 million in the third calendar quarter of 2026.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, which predates the end of Q3 calendar 2026 (July-Sept 2026) and any earnings report for that period. No knowledge establishes Nike's net income for that quarter.
